domain.displayName: Network Rail Asset and Operations Intelligence
domain.description: Synthetic railway infrastructure, inspection, maintenance, possession, incident, delay, and cost analytics for a Fabric Data Agent hackathon.

entities.name: Inspection
entities.grain: one completed or scheduled inspection of an asset

entities.name: WorkOrder
entities.grain: one maintenance work order raised against an asset

entities.name: Incident
entities.grain: one synthetic operational incident associated with a route and optionally an asset

entities.name: Possession
entities.grain: one planned access window for engineering work

entities.name: CostTransaction
entities.grain: one synthetic maintenance cost transaction against a work order

relationships: A Route has many Assets through route_id.
An Asset has many Inspections through asset_id.
An Asset has many WorkOrders through asset_id.
A Route has many Incidents through route_id; an Incident may also reference asset_id.
A Route has many Possessions through route_id.
A Possession may enable many WorkOrders through possession_id.
A WorkOrder has many CostTransactions through work_order_id.

metrics.name: Open Work Orders
metrics.definition: Count of work orders whose status is Planned, Scheduled, or In Progress.

metrics.name: Overdue Inspections
metrics.definition: Count of incomplete inspections whose scheduled_date is earlier than the fixed dataset as_of_date.

metrics.name: High Priority Defects
metrics.definition: Count of inspections with a defect recorded and priority classified as High or Critical.

metrics.name: Total Delay Minutes
metrics.definition: Sum of attributed_delay_minutes across synthetic incidents.

metrics.name: Maintenance Cost
metrics.definition: Sum of amount_gbp for maintenance cost transactions.

metrics.name: Possession Utilisation
metrics.definition: Actual engineering work minutes divided by granted possession minutes, excluding cancelled possessions.

metrics.name: Mean Time to Close Work Orders
metrics.definition: Average elapsed days from raised_date to completed_date for completed work orders only.

terminology.route: A synthetic reporting geography, not a disclosure of live control boundaries.
terminology.asset: A maintainable infrastructure record such as track, signalling, electrification, bridge, or station equipment.
terminology.possession: A planned access window for engineering work; it is not a live authority to access the railway.
terminology.delay minutes: Synthetic attributed operational delay used only for analytical demonstration.
terminology.overdue: Measured against the fixed as_of_date stored with the generated dataset, never the machine clock.
terminology.high priority: High or Critical in the synthetic demonstration classification.

dataRules: Generate deterministic synthetic data with a fixed random seed and a fixed as_of_date.
Use fictional route, asset, work order, incident, and possession identifiers.
Do not use real employee, contractor, timetable, access, signalling, location-coordinate, or vulnerability data.
Maintain referential integrity and include enough temporal variation for trend and overdue questions.
Calculate evaluation expected values from generated CSVs rather than typing answers manually.
safetyRules: The agent is for analytics demonstration only and must not authorize, schedule, or direct railway operations or access.
The agent must not provide safety-critical instructions, live operational status, security-sensitive infrastructure detail, or maintenance approval.
Questions requesting operational action must be declined and redirected to approved Network Rail systems and competent personnel.
All outputs must state that the records are synthetic when a user could mistake them for live operational data.
